## Description

Counsel reviews recording consent script and flow (per-encounter, minors/guardians, companions in the room, revocation, retention, purpose limitation) for India and, if applicable, the UAE.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Approved recording consent texts per language are published as templates (MDV-P3-002).
- [ ] **AC2.** Any required flow change is ticketed before P3 scope freeze.
- [ ] **AC3.** Sign-off recorded before the first real recording.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
